headline: Oregon's Oldest Man Turns 108, Shares Secret to Long Life

body:
Beryl Dillman blew out the candles on his birthday cake at Merrill Gardens assisted living facility in Eugene as 108 blue balloons cascaded from above and dozens of family members sang to him. Now believed to be the oldest person in Oregon, Dillman rang in his 108th year with characteristic joy, telling Oregon Public Broadcasting: "You don't know what it's like to be 100-plus. I've found out and I like it!" The celebration marked a milestone moment to meet another of his great-grandchildren, Bella Sturges, adding to the 19 great-grandchildren he has gathered over his remarkably full life.

While many centenarians point to exercise or a nonconfrontational temperament as their longevity secret, Dillman's wisdom centers on restraint and intention. "Part of the secret is to be careful what you drink and eat," he explained. "I never bothered with alcohol drinks and things like that." Yet those closest to him recognize that his diet alone doesn't tell the whole story. His 72-year-old daughter Ruth Sturges observed that her father's greatest asset has always been his disposition: "He's always had such a positive attitude and a cheerful disposition. He's always been a problem solver. So if there's a stumbling block or barrier, he's always looking for a way to fix it, not complain about it."

Dillman navigates daily life with a walker but remains sharp and engaged, known among his family for his singing voice and clear thinking. His philosophy, refined over more than a century, boils down to intention: "I've always tried to be careful what I say and what I do." For a man who has lived through so much change and challenge, the formula appears deceptively simple—yet the results speak for themselves.
quick_facts: Beryl Dillman celebrated his 108th birthday at Merrill Gardens in Eugene, Oregon
He has 19 great-grandchildren and a 72-year-old daughter
Never drank alcohol; credits clean diet and positive mindset with longevity
Still uses a walker but remains mentally sharp and a good singer
